title: sycl-agent run record
description: Immutable evidence for ONE command executed on ONE machine at ONE commit. Produced by .sycl/scripts/evidence.sh record; never hand-written. A state claim is only valid if a run record proves it.

run_id.description: <class>-<subject>-<UTC stamp>-<sha6>; unique, sortable, and the filename stem of both the record and its log.

class.description: Evidence class. test = correctness gate; bench = single-kernel performance; e2e = whole-workload performance/accuracy; build = compile transcript; profile = deep-profile capture.

subject.description: Kernel id for test/bench/profile; e2e case label (or 'baseline'/'final') for e2e; target name for build.

label.description: Which point in the story this run belongs to: baseline | final | migrate | trial-<n> | case-<name>. Baseline/final comparisons are built from this.

command.description: EXACT command executed, copy-pasteable for reproduction. Never a paraphrase.

via.description: How it was routed: 'run.sh test' | 'run.sh bench' | 'run.sh exec' | 'local'.

env_fingerprint.description: Id of the machine snapshot in evidence/env/<id>.json. Two numbers are only comparable when this matches.

commit.description: git commit (short) of the code under test.

dirty.description: Working tree had uncommitted changes at capture time; the run is not reproducible from git alone.

exit_code.description: The machine's verdict. verdict:'pass' REQUIRES exit_code == 0 — the agent cannot override it.

verdict.description: pass/fail for gated runs (test, e2e accuracy); 'recorded' for measurement-only runs (bench, profile, build).

log.description: Path (relative to .sycl/reports/) of the RAW stdout+stderr capture.

log_sha256.description: Hash taken at capture; re-checked by `evidence.sh verify` so a later edit or a lost sync is detected.

log_truncated.description: True when the log exceeded the capture cap and the middle was elided (head+tail kept).

artifacts.description: Extra files this run produced (metric CSVs, asm dumps, traces, plots), hashed for the manifest.

kind.description: csv | asm | json | pdf | trace | other

measurements.description: The numbers a reviewer checks. Auto-parsed from the log where the format allows, otherwise supplied by `evidence.sh annotate --set`. Anything here must also be readable in the raw log.

reference.description: Correctness oracle used, with its source path (e.g. 'cpu-oracle fp64 accum, dev/common.hpp:validate_result').

source.description: Where the tolerance was inherited from — proves it was not loosened.

shape.description: Problem size for this run (one record per shape).

seed.description: Input seed — with shape+dtype this regenerates the exact inputs.

samples_ms.description: EVERY timed iteration. Kept raw so a reviewer can recompute the median and see a bimodal/drifting run that a lone median hides.

extracted.description: Auto-parsed key/value pairs lifted verbatim from the log by the capture wrapper. Advisory: `measurements` is what the audit reads.
